summary: Early read on Wednesday, before the press conferences. The main question is Arsenal's defence: Saliba is back to full fitness and Sky Sports frames it as Saliba or Konsa. Villa's Manzambi looks doubtful with his calf problem, while Rayan's knock on international duty isn't serious. Thiago's suspension starts against Everton, as FPL already shows. Friday's 15:00 briefing will update this after the managers have spoken.

players.name: Konsa
players.verdict: Coin-flip: Sky Sports says Arteta has a selection dilemma now Saliba is fully fit, although Konsa scored for England over the break.
